use: Visual art-direction reference, not an implemented game asset
prompt:
Use case: product-mockup. Asset type: realistic visual reference for rebuilding a first-person shooter game prop, not a screenshot claiming an implemented change.
Input image 1 is a reference for the object, placement, surrounding pale limestone wall and red sign, not for its low polygon quality.
Create one photorealistic art-direction image of a believable wall-mounted red fire extinguisher in that same warm, worn stone setting. Replace the crude faceted cylinder with real manufactured construction: smooth subtly imperfect red powder-coated steel tank, rounded shoulder and dished base, rolled seams, sturdy metal mounting bracket attached to the wall with visible fixings, brass valve assembly, paired black and steel squeeze handles, small circular pressure gauge, metal safety pin and tamper seal. A thick flexible black rubber hose makes a natural curve down the right side, with a proper nozzle retained in a small clip. Show mechanically plausible connections and a subtle gap behind the tank with grounded contact shadows.
Give the tank a slightly aged off-white printed identification label with the clearly legible heading 'FIRE EXTINGUISHER', restrained black pictograms and realistic smaller print. Keep the red identification sign above it, but give it a recognizable white extinguisher pictogram instead of a blank white square. Material finish matters: restrained chips around the base and bracket, tiny scratches and dull rubbed areas on red paint, a little dust in creases, oxidized screw heads, realistic rubber roughness and metal highlights. Maintained serviceable equipment, not heavily rusted or destroyed. Avoid pristine plastic toy surfaces, sharp low polygon silhouettes, flat color blocks, exaggerated grime and decorative fantasy details.
Composition: a single full extinguisher and its sign, near-frontal slight three-quarter view at eye level so the tank volume, hardware, bracket and hose are clearly understandable. Portrait framing, tight enough to study the details, enough space to include the complete extinguisher, sign and contact with the stone wall. Soft natural side lighting, warm neutral palette, realistic scale and photographic microtexture. No people, no unrelated props, no collage, no arrows, no annotations, no watermark.
